newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: OTE BUYS PART OF SERBIAN PTT.
newsitem.headline: OTE BUYS PART OF SERBIAN PTT.

text.p: Serbian Post and Communications (PTT) on Monday sold a 49 precent stake in its telecoms department to Stet of Italy and OTE of Greece in a deal worth close to $1 billion, a senior Serbian official said on Monday.
"The deal was signed as we planned. We got 1.568 billion German marks for 49 percent stake of Serbian telecom," Dragan Peric, Serbian PTT deputy general manager told Reuters.

No official details were released about Serbia's first major privatisation deal, but government sources said Telekom Srbija was expected to sell a 29 percent of its stake to Stet and 20 percent to OTE for a total of around $1 billion.
According to the sources, Stet would pay around $650 million immediately after signing the deal with the remaining sum in two tranches by January 1, 1998.
The deal, the biggest in Serbia in a decade, was scheduled for Sunday afternoon but was postponed to finalise "some technicalities," a source close to the Serbian negotiating team said on Sunday.
